- The rot appears dry and shriveled, affecting multiple fingers in the bunch
- This tip-rot pattern is the hallmark of Cigar End Rot (named because the rotted tip resembles the burned end of a cigar)

Anthracnose would show more scattered dark spots across the fruit surface, not concentrated tip rot.
